name: Dribbble public profile pages
tier_rationale: Identifiable operator (Dribbble Holdings Ltd.) with published terms of service and a privacy policy and more than ten years of public track record as a design community (A8 community). P113 FC8 overlay record: 'major profile platform'.

reliability.justification: Authoritative for whether a profile exists under a handle; profile content is self-asserted, and the same handle on another site does not prove identity (P113 FC13).

profile_page.title: Public profile page https://dribbble.com/{handle} (P113 username_check two-sided markers)

terms.quote: Not reviewed by legal_dpo (A1 'unknown'). The terms (updated March 17, 2025) prohibit "Using any automated system, including without limitation "robots," "spiders," "offline readers," etc., to access the Website or any Services in a manner that sends more request messages to the Dribbble servers than a human can reasonably produce in the same period of time" and "Collecting or harvesting any personally identifiable information or User information, including account names".
terms.reviewer: batch p1-G05-2 (terms quoted for the legal_dpo review queue)

profile_page.notes: One unauthenticated GET per handle (P113 FC7/FC9). Stays out of the default pack until legal records 'open' terms with evidence (FC16), a personal_data_review exists (FC14) and the team re-calibrates it from its own egress (FC2).

notes: Owned by batch p1-G05-2 (P113 username_check / username_check_extended): host used only by this batch (providers_seed owners.json). Hit semantics: 200 + og:type profile = profile page; 404 + the 'Sorry, the page you were looking for' title = no profile under that handle.
